# checkmk_user (Resource)

Manages a CheckMK user. Users can authenticate via password or automation secret. Does not require activation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic user with password authentication
resource "checkmk_user" "operator" {
  username = "jsmith"
  fullname = "John Smith"
  email    = "jsmith@example.com"

  auth_type = "password"
  password  = "SecurePassword123!"
}
```

```terraform
# Automation user for API access
resource "checkmk_user" "api_user" {
  username = "terraform_automation"
  fullname = "Terraform Automation User"

  auth_type         = "automation"
  automation_secret = "your-automation-secret-here"

  # Automation users typically have admin role
  roles = ["admin"]

  # Disable GUI login for automation users
  disable_login = true
}
```

```terraform
# User with contact group memberships
resource "checkmk_contact_group" "linux_admins" {
  name  = "linux_admins"
  alias = "Linux Administrators"
}

resource "checkmk_contact_group" "database_admins" {
  name  = "database_admins"
  alias = "Database Administrators"
}

resource "checkmk_user" "dba" {
  username = "dba_alice"
  fullname = "Alice DBA"
  email    = "alice@example.com"

  contact_groups = [
    checkmk_contact_group.linux_admins.name,
    checkmk_contact_group.database_admins.name,
  ]

  roles = ["user"]

  auth_type = "password"
  password  = "DBAPassword123!"
}
```

```terraform
# User with specific roles
resource "checkmk_user" "admin_user" {
  username = "admin_jdoe"
  fullname = "Jane Doe (Admin)"
  email    = "jdoe@example.com"

  roles = ["admin"]

  auth_type = "password"
  password  = "AdminPassword123!"
}

resource "checkmk_user" "readonly_user" {
  username = "viewer_bob"
  fullname = "Bob View"
  email    = "bob@example.com"

  roles = ["guest"]

  auth_type = "password"
  password  = "ViewerPassword123!"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fullname` (String) Full name of the user.
- `username` (String) Unique username for the user. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type: 'password' or 'automation'. Default is 'password'.
- `automation_secret` (String, Sensitive) Automation secret for the user. Required if auth_type is 'automation'. Sensitive.
- `contact_groups` (List of String) List of contact group names the user belongs to.
- `disable_login` (Boolean) If true, the user cannot log in to the GUI.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `enforce_password_change` (Boolean) If true, user must change password on next login. Only applies to password auth.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the user. Required if auth_type is 'password'. Sensitive.
- `roles` (List of String) List of roles assigned to the user. Common roles: 'admin', 'user', 'guest'.
- `strict_resource_locking` (Boolean) Override provider-level strict_resource_locking for this resource. Controls ETag validation for resource operations. If not set, uses provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the user (same as username).
